system.description:
A cunning fighter from any background who wins by outthinking rather than outmuscling.

  • Exploit Opening: you score a critical hit on a 19 or 20 against a creature that is Prone, Restrained, Blinded or surprised, or that an ally is flanking with you.
    • 9th level: when you score a critical hit, the target also has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.
  • Read the Room: Advantage on Insight when reading opponents, and on checks to case a place or a situation before you act.
